care.title: Your flowers
care.intro: A few minutes now keeps them for a week or more.
steps: Trim each stem at an angle, about two centimetres, with a clean knife or scissors.
Fill a clean vase with cool water and the flower food in the card.
Strip any leaves that would sit below the water.
Keep them out of direct sun, away from radiators and away from the fruit bowl.
Change the water and trim again every two days.
care.lasts: Most of our arrangements last a week; garden roses and dahlias a little less, chrysanthemums much longer.
